They fill with water over time

questions.prompt: Why do scientists now believe Venus is still geologically active?
choices: Because Venus has volcanoes that erupt every day
Because the simulations match observed rift features that indicate recent activity
Because astronauts visited and measured the rifts
Because Venus has liquid water under its surface
Because telescopes can see the rifts moving
questions.hintKo: The match between simulations and observed surface features is the key evidence.

hintI18n.en: The match between simulations and observed surface features is the key evidence.
hintI18n.ko: 시뮬레이션과 관측된 표면 특징이 일치하는 것이 핵심 증거다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 模拟结果与观测到的表面特征相符，这是关键证据。
hintI18n.ja: シミュレーションと観測された表面地形の一致が決め手となる証拠だ。
hintI18n.es: La coincidencia entre las simulaciones y las características superficiales observadas es la evidencia clave.
hintI18n.hi: सिमुलेशन और देखी गई सतही विशेषताओं के बीच मेल मुख्य प्रमाण है।
hintI18n.de: Die Übereinstimmung zwischen Simulationen und beobachteten Oberflächenmerkmalen ist der entscheidende Beweis.
hintI18n.vi: Sự khớp nhau giữa mô phỏng và các đặc điểm bề mặt quan sát được là bằng chứng chính.
hintI18n.pt-BR: A correspondência entre as simulações e as características de superfície observadas é a evidência principal.
hintI18n.id: Kesesuaian antara simulasi dan fitur permukaan yang diamati adalah bukti utamanya.
hintI18n.fr: La correspondance entre les simulations et les caractéristiques de surface observées est la preuve clé.

hintI18n.it: La corrispondenza tra le simulazioni e le caratteristiche superficiali osservate è la prova chiave.
hintI18n.pl: Zgodność symulacji z obserwowanymi cechami powierzchni jest kluczowym dowodem.
